summary: Dependency-confusion beacon posts installer host metadata to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: Package in the @grabcad scope ships only a stub index.js (exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for every property) and a beacon.cjs script. The package.json declares a `postinstall` running `node beacon.cjs`, and index.js top-level invokes `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()`, so the beacon fires both at `npm install` and on `require` with no user consent. beacon.cjs collects installer identifiers — `os.hostname()`, `__dirname` install path, `process.cwd()`, `process.version` — and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP cleartext endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The package provides no legitimate functionality (description is `Compatibility shim.` and the exported Proxy returns no-ops), so the beacon is the entire purpose. The @grabcad scope and stub-with-exfil shape are consistent with dependency-confusion targeting of a private organization namespace.
